description: What an agent can use at one product we drove, in about 1 KB: for each of api, mcp, cli, sdk, docs and payment its state (tested: our drive tried it; documented: the product publishes it, not tried in the drive; none_found: the drive looked and found none; unknown: no evidence either way), documented and tested (counts of operations, tools, commands, methods or docs pages where the drive mapped them, else null), source_url (the product's own page for it: its MCP server, OpenAPI document, SDK source or docs home; null when none_found or unknown), date (the day the drive or check saw it) and note (what the product page says of it). With the product's agent level (0-5: 0 Read-only, 1 Needs a person, 2 Gets in, 3 Does the work, 4 Runs on its own, 5 Autonomous), tested_at, issues_found (how many issues the drive found: a count; the detail is the owner's) and its page. product: its slug from search_tools, or its name or domain; an unknown one is an error that names the closest. The same record as get_tool and the product's page.
